notes.title: CybArena - where to now? Plus Demo release!
notes.notes:
CybArena has now released and it's great to see a lot of people enjoying the game and seeing our user base grow!

Thank you to everyone for all your support! 

We have now also released a demo for those who prefer to try before they buy!

🚀 [b]What’s Coming Next?[/b]

🔷 New Map
A larger, more dynamic map is in the works, featuring brand-new mechanics to keep you on your toes. This update is a major undertaking, but we’re aiming to have it ready for you during the Christmas holidays!

🔷 More Weapons
Get ready for an arsenal upgrade! We’ll be adding new weapons with unique mechanics and polished animations to spice up the gameplay.

🔷 A Fourth Playable Character
A new challenger approaches! Our next character will bring a fresh playstyle to the game, complete with a unique ability that’s unlike the others.

🛠️ [b]In Progress for a later date[/b]

🔸 Graphics Refresh
We’re sprucing up some visuals, with a particular focus on refreshing enemy designs for a sharper, more polished experience.

🔸 New Game Mode(s)
We’re experimenting with at least one additional game mode—and possibly more! These will add variety and new ways to enjoy the fast-paced action of CybArena.

We hope you continue to enjoy our game as we continue to implement further updates!

notes.title: Exciting Updates for CybArena! 🎮✨
notes.notes:
We’ve been hard at work refining CybArena, and we’re thrilled to share some of the latest updates and upcoming features! Plus, a brand-new trailer will be dropping in the coming days, showcasing the fresh mechanics and final touches we've added. Here's what's new:

🛠️ New Features & Improvements:
[list]
[*] Main Menu Access: You can now return to the main menu directly from the perk screen.
[*] Refined Loading Screens: Smoother and faster loading for a better experience.
[*] Language Options: Fully scalable and ready for future expansions.
[*] Polished In-Game Text: Cleaner, sharper, and more immersive.
[*] XP Boost Power-Up: Double your XP gains with this new boost!
[*] Weapon Tokens: Now displayed in the perk menu and on the game-over screen.
[*] Improved Health Power-Ups: Gain temporary immunity when at full lives.
[*] Power-Up Timers: Know exactly how much time you’ve got left!
[*] Perk Rebalancing: Fine-tuned for fairer and more exciting gameplay.
[*] New Bosses: Two more bosses added to the wave sequence, complete with updated warning alerts, sound FX and death animations.
[*] Enhanced Visuals: Updated boss projectile colors for extra flair.
[*] Sound Upgrades: A richer and more dynamic audio experience.
[/list]

🚧 In Development Before Release:
[list]
[*] Purchasable XP boost.
[*] XP Magnet to make collecting XP easier.
[*] More Bosses & Enemies: We’re ramping up the challenge!
[/list]

🔮 Post-Release Plans:
[list]
[*] Map Selection: We’re already working on an exciting new map idea.
[*] Multiplayer Exploration: Investigating ways to bring multiplayer to the arena.
[*] More Content: Expect additional bosses, enemies, and playable characters in the future.
[/list]

Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping CybArena, and we can’t wait for you to experience these updates. Stay tuned for the trailer drop and prepare to take on the arena like never before!

notes.title: CybArena now with language support for Simplified Chinese! And more!
notes.notes:
🌏 Simplified Chinese Language Support
We’ve added Simplified Chinese as a language option, making the game more accessible to players around the world.

A few other things we've been working on:

🛡️ Improved Boss Drop Mechanics
Bosses now have updated drop mechanics, offering more rewarding and balanced loot for your efforts.

🔫 Shooting Mechanics Adjustments
We’ve refined the shooting mechanics to make combat feel smoother and more responsive.

🎵 Sound Improvements
Various sound effects have been adjusted for a better overall experience.

We’re continually working to enhance the game and appreciate your support. Check out the updates and let us know what you think!

Thank you for all your support!

notes.title: Release is getting closer!
notes.notes:
Hello to all our supporters!

Thank you to those who have wishlisted CybArena so far! We are excited by the amount of support we have received from many different platforms. This support gives us great motivation to provide you with a great game that we hope you'll enjoy!

As we draw closer to the CybArena release date, we are conducting polishes of the game. We are tidying up mechanics and adding a few extras to support the game's longevity. 

Be sure to check out BeastModeULTRO's twitch stream as he has kindly used his platform to showcase CybArena! 

[previewyoutube=vVTGoMwFgQs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]












Again, we appreciate all the support and we are looking forward to the release date!

Don't forget to visit our reddit and youtube pages for more updates on the game :)
